parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the main switch lever of the electrical wall switch, made of durable polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the actuator that toggles the electrical circuit on or off when pressed or flipped.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or pivotally within the base body to make or break the electrical connection.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the secondary switch lever of the electrical wall switch, also made of polycarbonate plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It provides an additional control point for another circuit or light, functioning similarly to the first switch.
parts.Movement_description: It moves pivotally within the base body, allowing toggling between on and off positions.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting plate of the electrical wall switch, made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It houses and supports the switch levers and internal electrical components, providing structural integrity and insulation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall or mounting box, serving as the main support structure.
